bibl.title: Kings and Elites in an Intercultural Tradition: From Diodorus to the Egyptian Temples.
bibl.seg: Stefano G. Caneva, Kings and Elites in an Intercultural Tradition: From Diodorus to the Egyptian Temples.
bibl.note: Cultural encounters in Hellenistic Egypt: the quest for literary echoes in Greek historiography. - Shaping identities in intercultural negotiation: a methodological premise. - Negotiating power legitimacy in Hellenistic Egypt: native agents, strategies, and media. - Diodorus' account of ancient pharaonic kingship and its Hellenistic premises. - Final remarks and a future research agenda.
